scene: campfire_en: Sera, I bought you a necklace. It's a gift. (Doyun watching)

plain_status_card.narration: Sera's fingers pause over her prayer beads, and the firelight catches the silver chain as she lifts it from your palm. "You didn't have to... but thank you. It's lovely," she murmurs, a faint flush rising as she fastens it at her throat and tucks the pendant just above her collar. Across the fire, Doyun's grin holds a beat too long before he snaps a twig and flicks it into the flames. "Wow, and here I thought we were all saving our coin for rations," he says lightly, though his eyes linger on the necklace instead of on you.

aethrion.narration:
(The firelight catches the necklace as you hold it out. For a moment Sera forgets the bush entirely.)

"…For me?" She takes it in both hands, turning the pendant so it glints orange. Her smile comes slowly, then all at once. "You picked this out yourself? I don't know what to say. Thank you. Really." She fastens it around her neck and keeps her fingers on it, as if it might disappear.

Across the fire, Doyun has stopped sharpening his blade. He watches the necklace settle at Sera's collar and his jaw tightens. He says nothing. When Sera glances his way, still glowing, he gives her a look that is a shade colder than it was a minute ago, then turns his back to the flames.

He pulls the small message-stone from his pocket and mutters into it, low and clipped, words meant for Harin somewhere out in the dark. A pause. Then the stone pulses faintly, and Harin's voice comes back, thin with distance but gentle:

"…I hear you, Doyun. Don't sit there chewing on it alone. I'm still a way out, but we'll talk when I'm back. You're all right."

Doyun's shoulders drop a little. He closes his hand around the stone and holds it longer than he needs to.

Sera, still touching the pendant, lowers her voice to you. "I'll treasure it." Then her eyes go back past your shoulder, and the smile thins.

The bush rustles again. Closer this time. Something small and yellow gleams between the leaves, and it isn't alone.

aethrion.narration:
Sera's eyes leave the bush. For a moment she only looks at the necklace in your hand, the firelight catching on its chain.

"…For me?" Her voice comes out smaller than she meant it to. She takes it carefully, as if it might vanish, and then the smile breaks through, bright and unguarded. "You bought this for me? You really did." She fastens it around her neck and presses her fingers to it. "I'm not taking it off. Just so you know."

Across the fire, Doyun has seen all of it. He says nothing. His jaw tightens, and the look he gives Sera lingers a little too long before he turns away and sits with his back to the flames. Hunched over, he scratches out a few quick lines and sends them off into the dark, toward wherever Harin is scouting.

The answer comes back before long. Harin is still far out and hours from returning, but the reply is gentle. Doyun reads it twice, and his shoulders ease a little. He tucks the message away, though he still won't look at Sera.

Sera doesn't notice. She is still smiling at the firelight on the pendant.

"Thank you," she says quietly. Then, remembering, she glances past you. "…That bush is still moving, though."

The leaves rustle again, low to the ground.
